description: F04 begins the TextAttribute/rendition burn-down with method-level evidence. Only contracts whose complete portable observables are directly reproduced are promoted; RenderSettings-dependent color projection remains Partial until the renderer integration owner is completed.

entries.notes: Rust iterates the same 0..0xdfff legacy attribute domain and skips the same reserved 0x2000 and leading/trailing DBCS bits. Every remaining attribute must round-trip through the production TextAttribute owner exactly.
